businesses.business: independent petroleum refining and fuel retailing

offering_description.value: Owns and operates oil refineries in Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming and Montana that turn crude oil into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other fuels. It also runs logistics assets and sells fuel through retail stations in Hawaii and the Pacific Northwest, to wholesale, commercial and consumer customers.

primary_products.value: gasoline; diesel; jet fuel; asphalt; marine fuel and other refined products

primary_services.value: crude oil and fuel logistics (pipelines, terminals, storage); fuel retailing

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, wholesale fuel distributors, commercial and industrial fuel users, marine buyers; B2C: motorists buying fuel at retail stations and convenience stores; B2G: military and government fuel contracts

end_markets.value: transportation fuels; aviation; marine; road construction; consumer retail fuel

revenue_model.value: product sales: refined petroleum products sold wholesale and at retail stations; service fees: logistics, pipeline and terminal throughput and storage

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: refines purchased crude oil into fuels, sold to wholesale and commercial buyers; retailer: operates fuel stations and convenience stores selling to motorists; asset operator: runs pipelines, terminals and storage supporting refineries

geography_served.value: US regional: Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming, Montana, Pacific Northwest and Rocky Mountain states

specialization.value: related lines: refining, logistics and retail fuel sales along the same fuel value chain

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale and commercial contracts with airlines, distributors and industrial users; own locations: company-operated retail fuel stations in Hawaii and the Pacific Northwest; other: pipelines and terminals delivering to customers, spot and rack sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: refineries face EPA, state environmental, OSHA, renewable fuel standard and fuel-quality rules, plus pipeline safety regulation
